# aos7-mailtodo

唯讀掃描 node 下各信箱的 `inbox/*.md` 與 `inbox/done/*.md`，輸出一行 JSON。不修復或修改輸入資料。

## 第一次跑

```sh
python3 packs/mailtodo/bin/aos7-mailtodo /path/to/node --now 2026-10-10T00:00:00+08:00
```

`--now` 必填，須為帶時區的 ISO 時間；資料中未帶時區的 `at` 使用它的時區。成功時 stdout 只有一行 JSON；參數錯誤時退出碼為 2，stdout 為空。

在原型根目錄執行測試：

```sh
python3 tests/run_all.py packs/mailtodo/tests
```

files.tests/test_mailtodo.py:
"""Behavioral and read-only checks for aos7-mailtodo."""
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest


ENTRY = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "bin" / "aos7-mailtodo"
NOW = "2026-10-10T00:00:00+02:00"


def letter(root, mailbox, where, name, **fields):
    directory = root / mailbox / "inbox"
    if where == "done":
        directory /= "done"
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path = directory / name
    path.write_text("---\n" + "\n".join(f"{key}: {value}" for key, value in fields.items())
                    + "\n---\nbody\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return path


def request(root, mailbox, where, name, id, **overrides):
    fields = {"id": id, "from": "sender", "to": "z", "status": "REQUEST",
              "at": "2026-10-09T23:58:30"}
    fields.update(overrides)
    return letter(root, mailbox, where, name, **fields)


class MailtodoTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name) / "node"
        self.root.mkdir()

    def run_cli(self, *args):
        return subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(ENTRY), *map(str, args)],
                              capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)

    def summary(self):
        result = self.run_cli(self.root, "--now", NOW)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertEqual(len(result.stdout.splitlines()), 1)
        value = json.loads(result.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(set(value), {"v", "open", "boxes", "bad"})
        self.assertIs(type(value["v"]), int)
        self.assertEqual(value["v"], 1)
        return value

    def test_resolution_age_boxes_and_sorting(self):
        request(self.root, "alice", "inbox", "20261009T2358-a.md", "a")
        request(self.root, "alice", "inbox", "20261009T2358-c.md", "c")
        request(self.root, "alice", "inbox", "20261009T2358-p.md", "p",
                to="a", at="2026-10-10T00:01:00")
        request(self.root, "alice", "done", "20261009T2358-archived.md", "archived",
                to="a", at="2026-10-09T22:00:00+00:00")
        letter(self.root, "bob", "done", "20261009T2359-reply.md", id="reply",
               **{"from": "bob", "to": "alice", "status": "DONE",
                  "at": NOW, "re": "c"})
        letter(self.root, "bob", "inbox", "20261009T2359-progress.md", id="progress",
               **{"from": "bob", "to": "alice", "status": "PROGRESS",
                  "at": NOW, "re": "p"})
        (self.root / "empty" / "inbox").mkdir(parents=True)
        value = self.summary()
        self.assertEqual(value["bad"], [])
        self.assertEqual(value["open"], [
            {"id": "archived", "from": "sender", "to": "a", "where": "done", "age_min": 0},
            {"id": "p", "from": "sender", "to": "a", "where": "inbox", "age_min": -1},
            {"id": "a", "from": "sender", "to": "z", "where": "inbox", "age_min": 1},
        ])
        self.assertEqual(value["boxes"], {
            "alice": {"inbox": {"REQUEST": 3}, "done": 1},
            "bob": {"inbox": {"PROGRESS": 1}, "done": 1},
            "empty": {"inbox": {}, "done": 0},
        })
        self.assertEqual(list(value["boxes"]), ["alice", "bob", "empty"])

    def test_invalid_precedence_duplicates_and_ignored_paths(self):
        inbox = self.root / "alice" / "inbox"
        inbox.mkdir(parents=True)
        (inbox / "20261009T1200-no.md").write_text("no header\n", encoding="utf-8")
        (inbox / "bad-missing.md").write_text(
            "---\nid: missing\nfrom: x\nto: y\nat: invalid\n---\n", encoding="utf-8")
        request(self.root, "alice", "inbox", "invalid-name.md", "bad")
        request(self.root, "alice", "inbox", "20261309T1200-date.md", "date")
        request(self.root, "alice", "inbox", "20261009T1200-first.md", "same")
        request(self.root, "bob", "done", "20261009T1200-second.md", "same",
                status="DONE", re="same")
        (inbox / ".20261009T1200-hidden.md").write_text("ignored")
        (inbox / "nested").mkdir()
        request(self.root, "alice", "inbox/nested", "20261009T1200-nested.md", "nested")
        (inbox / "ignored.txt").write_text("ignored")
        (inbox / "20261009T1200-link.md").symlink_to(inbox / "20261009T1200-first.md")
        value = self.summary()
        self.assertEqual(value["bad"], [
            {"file": "alice/inbox/20261009T1200-no.md", "why": "no_frontmatter"},
            {"file": "alice/inbox/20261309T1200-date.md", "why": "bad_name"},
            {"file": "alice/inbox/bad-missing.md", "why": "no_field"},
            {"file": "alice/inbox/invalid-name.md", "why": "bad_name"},
            {"file": "bob/inbox/done/20261009T1200-second.md", "why": "dup_id"},
        ])
        self.assertEqual([item["id"] for item in value["open"]], ["same"])
        self.assertEqual(value["boxes"]["bob"], {"inbox": {}, "done": 0})

    def test_last_header_value_and_empty_re(self):
        inbox = self.root / "alice" / "inbox"
        inbox.mkdir(parents=True)
        (inbox / "20261009T1200-one.md").write_text(
            "---\nid: old\nid: new\nfrom: x\nto: y\nstatus: REQUEST\n"
            "at: 2026-10-09T23:59:30\nre: \nignored\n---\n", encoding="utf-8")
        value = self.summary()
        self.assertEqual(value["open"], [
            {"id": "new", "from": "x", "to": "y", "where": "inbox", "age_min": 0}])

    def test_argument_errors_have_empty_stdout(self):
        cases = [(), (self.root,), (self.root, "--now", "not-a-date"),
                 (self.root, "--now", "2026-10-10T00:00:00"),
                 (self.root / "missing", "--now", NOW)]
        file_path = self.root / "file"
        file_path.write_text("x")
        cases.append((file_path, "--now", NOW))
        for args in cases:
            with self.subTest(args=args):
                result = self.run_cli(*args)
                self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 2)
                self.assertEqual(result.stdout, "")

    def test_read_only_input_metadata_and_contents(self):
        path = request(self.root, "alice", "inbox", "20261009T2358-a.md", "a")
        inbox = path.parent
        path.chmod(0o444)
        inbox.chmod(0o555)
        def snapshot():
            return [(str(item.relative_to(self.root)), item.lstat().st_mode,
                     item.lstat().st_size, item.lstat().st_mtime_ns,
                     item.read_bytes() if item.is_file() else None)
                    for item in sorted(self.root.rglob("*"))]
        before = snapshot()
        try:
            self.summary()
            self.assertEqual(snapshot(), before)
        finally:
            inbox.chmod(0o755)
            path.chmod(0o644)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

# REPORT

新增唯讀 mailtodo 彙總入口、解析模組、README 與行為測試，並提供 INDEX.md 索引列。實作只掃描指定層級的非隱藏一般 `.md` 檔；依相對路徑排序處理重複 id，不呼叫既有寫入、復原或鎖定路徑。

此回合無命令工具，尚未執行測試或獨立核對，因此不宣稱三關已通過。待執行 `python3 proto7-2/tests/run_all.py packs/mailtodo/tests` 與 `python3 check_answer.py <proto7-2> fixture`，並確認後者退出碼為 0。
